column1: # Known termux.properties keys. Source: official termux-tools termux.properties template (master, commit 05c857e, 2026-10-15).
# TSV: key<TAB>type<TAB>spec. Types: bool | enum(a|b) | int(min-max) | uint | intset(0|min-max) | path | shortcut | extra-keys.
# Template-verified: all keys above; the 'virtual' volume-keys value and 'show/hide' value come from wiki/defaults, not the template.
# The list can lag the app: an unknown key is a WARN to verify against the current Termux wiki, never an ERROR.
